metric_definitions.recall_at_5: Gold evidence groups covered by final ranked top five passages.
metric_definitions.mrr_at_5: First gold passage reciprocal rank in final ranked top five.
metric_definitions.latency_ms: Workflow execution including request-summary persistence; excludes auxiliary raw retrieval and HTTP overhead.
metric_definitions.first_round_recall_at_5: Gold evidence groups covered by first-round ranked top five passages.

metrics.semantic_support_measurement: Runtime verifier judgments are model-assessed, not independent hallucination labels.
